signals.title: Codex hardens the bubblewrap synthetic-mount registry against writable overlap and symlink redirection
signals.title_zh: Codex 强化 Bubblewrap Synthetic-Mount Registry，防止可写重叠与 Symlink 重定向
signals.summary: Codex now protects its Linux bubblewrap synthetic-mount registry with a read-only bind when a writable filesystem bind would expose it, applies that protection before deny masks, and rejects a pre-existing registry symlink before registration or command execution. Regression coverage exercises symlink rejection and denied temporary directories under both full-root and minimal policies.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 现在会在可写 Filesystem Bind 可能暴露 Linux Bubblewrap Synthetic-Mount Registry 时为该 Registry 加入只读 Bind，并在 Deny Mask 之前实施保护；同时在注册或命令执行前拒绝预先存在的 Registry Symlink。回归测试覆盖 Symlink 拒绝，以及 Full-Root / Minimal Policy 下被拒绝的临时目录。

signals.title: Codex preserves child-only developer-instruction provenance across full-history subagent forks
signals.title_zh: Codex 在 Full-History Subagent Fork 中保留仅属于子 Agent 的 Developer Instruction 来源分类
signals.summary: Codex adds a dedicated contextual fragment for developer instructions and uses it in full-history subagent forks so child-specific guidance retains the generic.developer_instructions classification, reaches the child exactly once, and does not appear in the parent request.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 为 Developer Instructions 增加专用 Contextual Fragment，并在 Full-History Subagent Fork 中使用它，使仅属于子 Agent 的指导保留 generic.developer_instructions 分类、恰好一次到达子 Agent，同时不进入父请求。

signals.title: Codex extends Guardian computer-use evidence and policy handling to cua_repl-backed MCP execution
signals.title_zh: Codex 将 Guardian 的 Computer-Use 证据与策略处理扩展到 cua_repl 支撑的 MCP 执行
signals.summary: Codex now recognizes cua_repl alongside node_repl when collecting bounded Guardian review evidence, applying computer-use policy, capturing transcript images and rendering REPL history. The change also preserves failed MCP call status and result content when app-server history is replayed.
signals.summary_zh: Codex 现在在收集有界 Guardian Review Evidence、应用 Computer-Use Policy、捕获 Transcript Image 与渲染 REPL History 时，将 cua_repl 与 node_repl 同等识别；同时在 App-Server History Replay 时保留失败 MCP Call 的状态与结果内容。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK completes owned sandbox dependency cleanup before propagating cancellation
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 在传播 Cancellation 前完成所拥有 Sandbox Dependency 的清理
signals.summary: The sandbox dependency owner now records cancellation raised by one owned result, continues closing the remaining owned results exactly once, clears internal dependency state, and only then re-raises the first cancellation. Regression coverage verifies repeated close calls do not duplicate cleanup.
signals.summary_zh: Sandbox Dependency Owner 现在会记录某个 Owned Result 抛出的 Cancellation，继续恰好一次关闭其余 Owned Results，清理内部依赖状态后才重新抛出第一次 Cancellation；回归测试验证重复 Close 不会造成重复清理。

signals.title: OpenAI Agents SDK preserves a tripped streaming input-guardrail exception when max-turns is also exceeded
signals.title_zh: OpenAI Agents SDK 在同时超过 Max Turns 时仍保留已触发的 Streaming Input Guardrail 异常
signals.summary: RunResultStreaming now marks the default MaxTurnsExceeded path as handled so a later error check cannot overwrite an already captured InputGuardrailTripwireTriggered exception. The regression test deterministically orders the max-turn condition and guardrail completion rather than relying on timing sleeps.
signals.summary_zh: RunResultStreaming 现在会把默认 MaxTurnsExceeded 路径标记为已处理，从而避免后续 Error Check 覆盖已经捕获的 InputGuardrailTripwireTriggered 异常；回归测试通过确定性同步 Max-Turn 条件与 Guardrail 完成顺序，而不是依赖 Sleep 猜测时序。
